clue.text: Inaccessible scripture test taken by no-one ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word no-one

explanation.surface: A religious exam that nobody ends up sitting is beyond anyone's reach.
explanation.walkthrough: MOT is the Ministry of Transport test every older British car must pass yearly.
explanation.definitionFit: A remote place is far away and hard to reach, so it is inaccessible.

explanation.definitionFit: A conundrum is a riddle or puzzling problem, a synonym for puzzle.

clue.text: Stick label back on

clue.text: Terribly dismal day for servant

explanation.definitionFit: A tea garden is an outdoor spot where refreshments are served, so a place to eat.

clue.text: £2 printed on book cover

clue.text: One crosses channel, visiting extremely cold French city in organised trips

explanation.surface: Somebody crosses the Channel to visit a freezing French city on package holidays.

explanation.definitionFit: Conducted tours are guided excursions arranged for groups, so organised trips.

clue.text: Portion of dessert, perhaps: crumble with no filling

indicators.note: with no filling means only the outside letters of crumble remain

explanation.definitionFit: A piece is a portion or slice of something.

clue.text: Russian child tours America, taking insurance without hesitation

explanation.walkthrough: 'without hesitation' strips ER from COVER, leaving COV.

clue.text: Speaker's travelled back, mostly in open-top car

clue.text: Vet disembowelled small creature

explanation.definitionFit: An insect is a tiny six-legged creature.

clue.text: Concerned with winning prize, ultimately, in vintage car rally

explanation.walkthrough: 'rally' looks like a motoring event but is the verb, to recover.

clue.text: Fruit fed to Roman goddess

clue.text: Shot outside, woman hides here for treatment?

clue.text: Short sketch about the writer getting old

parts.note: ca is circa, Latin for about
the writer refers to the setter, me

explanation.surface: A brief piece about the author growing older.

clue.text: Old Africans from north travelling in a bus

clue.text: Fury, maybe, as British PM secures a vote

explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' turns NIL into LIN.

clue.text: A welfare payment's very little money for teenager

explanation.walkthrough: 'the dole' is British unemployment benefit.

clue.text: So dad has lots of time, following a TV programme

clue.text: Amazing Sudanese ballerina

clue.text: Speak to a groom about what's central to wedding

clue.text: Fight using pole
